facts.name: Archer Aviation
sentences: Archer Aviation's shares moved 5% or more on 54 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 6 November 2026, when the stock rose 14.7%.
The stock is down 36.0% this year, and at $4.81 it sits 46.6% below its 52-week closing high of $9.01 from 22 January 2026.
$1,000 invested in Archer Aviation five years ago would be worth $794 today.
